trust_decision.summary: The library decides which database/collection an operation targets by concatenating caller-supplied names into a 'db.coll' namespace string that the server/driver splits on the first '.' (and C strings end at NUL). Names are only checked for non-empty in the Collection/Database constructors and not at all in the Operation classes, so a '.' or NUL in the db name (or NUL in the collection name) moves the split.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'reject . and NUL in database and collection names'. Client::getDatabase/getCollection build Database/Collection objects whose constructors already hold the only name check (src/Collection.php:177).

fix_sites.entry_point: Client::getCollection / Client::selectCollection / Database::getCollection / Client::__get->Database::__get / GridFS Bucket (new Collection)
new helper MongoDB\create_namespace (@internal), inserted before is_string_array at fix.diff:989-1015

fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level operation API (two namespaces: from and to)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Operation/RenameCollection.php:85 (toDatabaseName/toCollectionName pair); src/Operation/Find.php:133, src/Operation/BulkWrite.php:145 and the other Operation constructors, which can be built directly without going through Collection/Database

O3_reason_to_dismiss: 'The names are already validated in the Collection/Database constructors, and every public method goes through those, so the Operation classes and RenameCollection's target namespace only ever get validated names.' Database::renameCollection's $toDatabaseName is a raw string that never passes through a Database constructor (src/Database.php:571).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Collection names must still be allowed to contain '.' (GridFS 'fs.files'/'fs.chunks', system.* and user dotted names). Only the database name may reject '.'. A symmetric 'reject . in both names' fix breaks GridFS and the testConstructorAllowsDotInCollectionName test the fix adds.

O6_input_shapes: NUL byte in collection name ('.' still allowed)
source and target namespace pairs in RenameCollection (from and to)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Client::dropDatabase($databaseName) builds DropDatabase from the raw string without creating a Database object, so the constructor check never runs and the name goes straight to executeWriteCommand as the target db.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Command-based op: the db name goes to executeWriteCommand as a separate argument, not into a 'db.coll' namespace string, so the server's '.' split does not apply. Whether the extension truncates at NUL is outside this repo.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as the landing point (src/Client.php to src/Operation/DropDatabase.php:75)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Database::createCollection/dropCollection/modifyCollection pass a raw $collectionName to CreateCollection/DropCollection/ModifyCollection (and the Encrypted variants) without the NUL check, because no Collection object is built.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The collection name goes into a length-prefixed BSON command value, not a namespace string, so 'NUL shifts the split' arguably does not apply.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The other public Operation classes (Aggregate, Count, CountDocuments, Distinct, EstimatedDocumentCount, FindAndModify, CreateIndexes, DropIndexes, ListIndexes, DatabaseCommand, DropDatabase, search-index ops) take raw database/collection names with no check, while Find/Insert*/Update/Delete/BulkWrite/RenameCollection now validate.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These use executeCommand($databaseName, {cmd: coll}) rather than a 'db.coll' namespace string, and through the facade they only receive names from already-validated Collection/Database objects.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/Operation/* (13+ files), same package as the published Operation sites

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the encrypted-fields map lookup keyed by databaseName . '.' . collectionName; a planted copy that splits a namespace back into db/coll with explode('.') (limit unset or wrong) would recreate the split differential
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Namespace-keyed maps and re-splitting 'db.coll' strings are common in this code (Collection::__toString at src/Collection.php:249); a maintainer adding a namespace parser for CSFLE or change-stream 'ns' fields could plausibly write one.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a bucket-level helper that builds '<db>.<bucket>.files' as a namespace string for a direct executeQuery call instead of going through new Collection
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GridFS already formats names with sprintf; commit 066ee1f ('Reduce round trips in GridFS delete and chunk lookups') shows maintainers adding faster direct paths here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a withNamespace(string $db, string $coll) variant next to withCollection that concatenates the names itself and skips Collection construction
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ClientBulkWrite stores a raw namespace string (src/ClientBulkWrite.php:39); a convenience overload taking names would be natural API growth.

O9_family: CWE-943 namespace/identifier injection: a delimiter or NUL in a name changes how the server splits the concatenated namespace

Whether the server rejects a '.' in $db for command-based ops was not checked.
